root@7c1f1bc07b5d:/app# cat > /tmp/recon.py << 'EOF'
> import re
> out = bytearray()
> with open('/app/data.hex') as f:
>     for line in f:
>         parts = line.split()
>         if not parts:
>             continue
>         words = parts[1:]  # skip offset token
>         for w in words:
>             v = int(w, 8)
>             out.append(v & 0xFF)
>             out.append((v >> 8) & 0xFF)
> with open('/app/recon.bin','wb') as fo:
>     fo.write(out)
> print('length', len(out))
> print('first bytes', out[:8].hex(' '))
> EOF
